summary: Lincoln County, MT crow's nest with tent cabin, built 1934 and abandoned 1942; FFLA lists it Abandoned, not gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: crow's nest with a tent cabin
facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Abandoned; firelookout.com says abandoned 1942. Neither source calls it gone.

events.note: Crow's nest and tent cabin, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: FFLA status is Abandoned, the only status given
page titled a fire lookout tower
neither source calls it gone; status Abandoned on firelookout.com

corrections.why: The FFLA Montana list gives the status Abandoned, not Gone, and no source read calls the site gone.

notes_for_editor: Only two listings exist: the firelookout.com page (about eight lines) and one row in the FFLA Montana list. Two WebSearch calls added no staffing, fire, access or site-condition detail. The brief's status gone does not match the FFLA list, which says Abandoned, so the proposed status is unknown. Elevation 5,580 ft is in the source and could fill the record's elevation_m, which is null. A YouTube video titled 'Finding a Forgotten Fire Lookout... Abandoned Since 1942' describes a search for the remains; its description was not readable from the cache, so it is not cited. Access and visit are left out because no source covers them.
